Name: Magic Powder
Description: Implements Magic Powder (move 750) by cloning Soak's real routine (0x0C8658, timing 0xBF) byte-for-byte and changing its embedded 16-bit packed type descriptor at 0xC86E0 from Soak's Water/Water/None (0x494A = (18 << 10) | (10 << 5) | 10) to pure Psychic (0x49AD = (18 << 10) | (13 << 5) | 13), setting the target's type to pure Psychic. Move 750 in a/0/1/1 shares EffectSequence 294 with Soak.
